_notes: Hidden zones' bosses (tools/build_hidden_content.py). Item level is the boss's level + 5; every boss drops two of these (world/hidden_zones multi_drop); from level 30 one of them is a one-of-a-kind epic. Kyle, 14 Nov 2026: 'they drop at 4 to 5 ilvl and can have unique epics above level 30.'

Ashcaller Vorn.name: Vorn's Unburnt Hand
Ashcaller Vorn.flavor_text: A wand of fused bone. The cult said it never cooled.

Ashcaller Vorn.name: Cassock of the Inner Kiln
Ashcaller Vorn.flavor_text: Stitched from robes that went into the well and came back.

Ashcaller Vorn.name: Tithe-Taker's Grips
Ashcaller Vorn.flavor_text: Every finger is scarred where the coins were hot.

Ashcaller Vorn.name: Smoke-Stained Cord
Ashcaller Vorn.flavor_text: It smells of the deep vents no matter how long it's aired.

The Furnace Heart.name: Heartstone Maul
The Furnace Heart.flavor_text: It's warm. It's always going to be warm.

The Furnace Heart.name: Kilnplate Pauldrons
The Furnace Heart.flavor_text: Hammered out over the well itself.

The Furnace Heart.name: Ember of the Well
The Furnace Heart.flavor_text: A coal on a chain that has never gone out.

Vel'dran the Unwaking.name: Staff of the Unwaking
Vel'dran the Unwaking.flavor_text: Root, knotted round a pearl that dreams.

Vel'dran the Unwaking.name: Dreamwalker Leggings
Vel'dran the Unwaking.flavor_text: Worn by someone who walked a long way without waking.

Vel'dran the Unwaking.name: Thornbed Hauberk
Vel'dran the Unwaking.flavor_text: The thorns are on the inside. They don't hurt. That's worse.

Vel'dran the Unwaking.name: Somnus Band
Vel'dran the Unwaking.flavor_text: You feel rested wearing it, and you shouldn't.

Vel'dran the Unwaking.name: Pool-Drinker's Bracers
Vel'dran the Unwaking.flavor_text: Stained a green that won't wash out.

Gnasher, the Bone-Fed.name: Marrowcrack Axe
Gnasher, the Bone-Fed.flavor_text: Notched where it caught on something it didn't cut.

Gnasher, the Bone-Fed.name: Kennelmaster's Hide
Gnasher, the Bone-Fed.flavor_text: Whoever kept him here wore this. It didn't help.

The Archmage's Shade.name: Arugal's Last Lesson
The Archmage's Shade.flavor_text: A staff that still remembers the words.

The Archmage's Shade.name: Mantle of the Unquiet Mage
The Archmage's Shade.flavor_text: Cold to the touch even in summer.

The Archmage's Shade.name: Ossuary Warden's Coif
The Archmage's Shade.flavor_text: Taken off a guard who never left his post.

The Archmage's Shade.name: Signet of the Pale Study
The Archmage's Shade.flavor_text: Engraved on the inside: 'for my children'.

The Archmage's Shade.name: Grave-Cold Cuffs
The Archmage's Shade.flavor_text: They keep a wound from bleeding. They keep a lot of things.

Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.name: Ul'gotha's Unblinking Eye
Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.flavor_text: It closes when you sleep. Only then.

Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.name: Tidecrush Trident
Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.flavor_text: Pulled from the mother's mantle, still wet.

Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.name: Deepcoil Spaulders
Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.flavor_text: Shell, ground smooth by water that never saw light.

Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.name: Lurker-Skin Gloves
Ul'gotha, Mother of the Deep.flavor_text: Cold, slick, and they never slip.

Ja'kesh the Unchained.name: The Broken Chain
Ja'kesh the Unchained.flavor_text: He wore it for forty years and then he didn't.

Ja'kesh the Unchained.name: Shacklebreaker Gauntlets
Ja'kesh the Unchained.flavor_text: One link still dangles from each wrist.

Ja'kesh the Unchained.name: Bloodcaller's Loincloth
Ja'kesh the Unchained.flavor_text: Dyed the colour of the pit floor.

Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.name: Skrell's Last Clutch
Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.flavor_text: Three eggs on a cord. They never hatched.

Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.name: Mothershell Mantle
Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.flavor_text: Plates from her back, and they turn steel.

Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.name: Den-Stalker Treads
Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.flavor_text: You walk softer in them. So did she.

Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.name: Pit-Priest's Wraps
Skrell, Mother of Ravagers.flavor_text: Wound tight against the heat of the blood-fires.

Marginalia.name: Quill of Marginalia
Marginalia.flavor_text: It writes on its own if you let it.

Marginalia.name: Annotated Mantle
Marginalia.flavor_text: Notes in a hand nobody recognises cover every inch.

Marginalia.name: Scribe's Fingerless Gloves
Marginalia.flavor_text: Inkstains that move when you aren't looking.

The First Draft.name: The Unedited Word
The First Draft.flavor_text: A staff of pressed fungus-paper, and whatever it says, it means.

The First Draft.name: Bound Volume Breastplate
The First Draft.flavor_text: Pages hammered flat into plate. Some of them are still legible.

The First Draft.name: Archivist's Spore-Hood
The First Draft.flavor_text: Grows back if you cut it.

The First Draft.name: Stackwalker's Slippers
The First Draft.flavor_text: Made for long nights between the shelves.

The Brine King.name: Crown of the Drowned Thane
The Brine King.flavor_text: Salt-crusted gold. It still fits somebody.

The Brine King.name: Barrow-King's Bane
The Brine King.flavor_text: Buried with him so nobody else could have it.

The Brine King.name: Saltgrave Shroud
The Brine King.flavor_text: Grey wool, and never once dry.

The Brine King.name: Lantern-Keeper's Wraps
The Brine King.flavor_text: Warm, which is the strangest thing about them.

The Brine King.name: Tidewalker's Treads
The Brine King.flavor_text: Sand runs out of them forever.

Gullmother Shrike.name: Shrike-Feather Cloak
Gullmother Shrike.flavor_text: Grey and white, and it moves in a wind you can't feel.

Gullmother Shrike.name: Talon-Hook Knife
Gullmother Shrike.flavor_text: One of her claws, fitted with a grip.

Gullmother Shrike.name: Gull-Bone Wristguards
Gullmother Shrike.flavor_text: Light as anything and harder than they look.

Old Blister.name: Blister's Fused Fang
Old Blister.flavor_text: Half tooth, half glass. Sharper than either.

Old Blister.name: Glasswalker's Jerkin
Old Blister.flavor_text: Basilisk hide that turns a blade.

Old Blister.name: Kiln-Fired Gauntlets
Old Blister.flavor_text: Hammered out on a hot stone in the canyon.

Old Blister.name: Shard of the Glasswaste
Old Blister.flavor_text: It holds the heat of a fire nobody lit.

Old Blister.name: Ashfoot's Hauberk
Old Blister.flavor_text: Durek's old mail, from before he stopped going out.

The Widow of the Mere.name: Veil of the Weeping Widow
The Widow of the Mere.flavor_text: Black lace, soaked through and never dripping.

The Widow of the Mere.name: Mere-Drowned Longbow
The Widow of the Mere.flavor_text: Strung with something that isn't gut.

The Widow of the Mere.name: Mourning Band
The Widow of the Mere.flavor_text: Inside it says 'until the water's still'.

The Widow of the Mere.name: Pinewalker's Leggings
The Widow of the Mere.flavor_text: They make no noise at all.

Old Hollowbark.name: Hollowbark Shield
Old Hollowbark.flavor_text: Cut from his chest. He's hollow there anyway.

Old Hollowbark.name: Pinesap Gloves
Old Hollowbark.flavor_text: Sticky with something that smells like rain.

Old Hollowbark.name: Mosswalker Boots
Old Hollowbark.flavor_text: Soft soled, made for dead ground.

Grandfather Mangrove.name: Mangrove-Heart Staff
Grandfather Mangrove.flavor_text: A living branch. It still puts out leaves in spring.

Grandfather Mangrove.name: Shoalwalker Boots
Grandfather Mangrove.flavor_text: They grip wet roots like they were made for it.

Grandfather Mangrove.name: Seed of the Old Wood
Grandfather Mangrove.flavor_text: It's warm, and it's growing. Slowly.

Old Snag-Jaw.name: Snag-Tooth Dagger
Old Snag-Jaw.flavor_text: One of his teeth. He has plenty more.

Old Snag-Jaw.name: Crocscale Bracers
Old Snag-Jaw.flavor_text: Tough enough to turn a bite.

Gnarl the Unburied.name: Gnarlwood Bludgeon
Gnarl the Unburied.flavor_text: Pulled out of him. He didn't miss it.

Gnarl the Unburied.name: Unburied Mantle
Gnarl the Unburied.flavor_text: Moss grows on it even in a bag.

Gnarl the Unburied.name: Rootknot Ring
Gnarl the Unburied.flavor_text: A ring of living root. It tightens when you're hurt.

Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.name: Tear of the Sap-Mother
Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.flavor_text: A drop of amber with a flower in it that hasn't grown anywhere for ten thousand years.

Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.name: Amber-Sealed Aegis
Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.flavor_text: A shield with a beetle in it the size of your hand. It's still alive.

Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.name: Amberplate Greaves
Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.flavor_text: Plate set in amber, and the amber doesn't crack.

Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.name: Heartwood Grips
Amberheart, the Sap-Mother.flavor_text: Carved from the inside of the tree.

The Root-Father.name: World-Root
The Root-Father.flavor_text: A staff cut from the root of the oldest tree in the world. It cut back.

The Root-Father.name: Root-Father's Reach
The Root-Father.flavor_text: A spear of root as hard as iron and twice as patient.

The Root-Father.name: Crown of Living Wood
The Root-Father.flavor_text: Small white flowers open on it at dawn.

The Root-Father.name: Treewalker's Hauberk
The Root-Father.flavor_text: Rings of bark, linked like mail.

The Root-Father.name: Hollow-Stalker Leggings
The Root-Father.flavor_text: You don't make a sound in them.

Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.name: Eye of the Drowned God
Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.flavor_text: A jade eye on a cord of hair. It blinks.

Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.name: Waterlogged Ritual Robes
Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.flavor_text: They never dry, and they never rot.

Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.name: Idol-Breaker's Pauldrons
Idol-Keeper Zun'jal.flavor_text: Hammered from the bronze of a drowned god.

Mother Mire.name: Mire-Mother's Knuckles
Mother Mire.flavor_text: Big enough for her. They'll do for you.

The Last Caravan Master.name: The Master's Ledger
The Last Caravan Master.flavor_text: Every debt ever owed this caravan, in a hand that never shook.

The Last Caravan Master.name: Caravan-Breaker
The Last Caravan Master.flavor_text: A wagon axle, sharpened. He wasn't picky.

The Last Caravan Master.name: Dune-Buried Breastplate
The Last Caravan Master.flavor_text: Sand pours out of it for a week.

The Last Caravan Master.name: Silk of the Lost Market
The Last Caravan Master.flavor_text: The finest thing the caravan carried.

Old Stinger.name: Stinger's Barb
Old Stinger.flavor_text: Still wet at the tip. Don't lick it.

Old Stinger.name: Chitin Pauldrons
Old Stinger.flavor_text: Plates off the oldest scorpid in the desert.

The Thorn-Mother's Echo.name: Thorn-Mother's Last Word
The Thorn-Mother's Echo.flavor_text: A thorn staff that still flowers when it's angry.

The Thorn-Mother's Echo.name: Kraal-Queen's Mantle
The Thorn-Mother's Echo.flavor_text: Quills, every one of them sharp.

The Thorn-Mother's Echo.name: Echo of the Kraal
The Thorn-Mother's Echo.flavor_text: You can hear the drums in it.

Gutripper.name: Boarhide Hauberk
Gutripper.flavor_text: Bristles on the outside, for the look of it.

Gutripper.name: Pit-Fighter's Wraps
Gutripper.flavor_text: They've seen a lot of fights.

The Unlit Priestess.name: Moonless Glaive
The Unlit Priestess.flavor_text: A sentinel's glaive that has never once caught the moonlight.

The Unlit Priestess.name: Vigil-Keeper's Helm
The Unlit Priestess.flavor_text: The eyes are blindfolded on the inside.

The Unlit Priestess.name: Shard of a Dead Moon
The Unlit Priestess.flavor_text: Cold enough to frost the skin.

The Calling Stone.name: Stormcaller's Mace
The Calling Stone.flavor_text: Lightning-scarred, and lighter than it should be.

The Calling Stone.name: Crag-Rider's Hauberk
The Calling Stone.flavor_text: Rings of iron, every one fused by a strike.

The Calling Stone.name: Standing-Stone Pauldrons
The Calling Stone.flavor_text: Cut from a stone that fell over.

Skyrender.name: Gale-Walker Boots
Skyrender.flavor_text: You never lose your footing in them.

Old Bramley.name: Bramley's Harvest Scythe
Old Bramley.flavor_text: Still keen. Still hungry for a harvest.

Old Bramley.name: Orchard-Keeper's Smock
Old Bramley.flavor_text: Patched a hundred times, and every patch an apple.

The Cider-Wife.name: Cider-Press Mallet
The Cider-Wife.flavor_text: Stained a colour no apple should be.

The Cider-Wife.name: Bitterbrew Belt
The Cider-Wife.flavor_text: There's still a flask on it. Leave it.

The Thorn-Mother.name: Crown of the Thorn-Mother
The Thorn-Mother.flavor_text: It draws a little blood, every day, to stay alive.

The Thorn-Mother.name: Heartroot Spear
The Thorn-Mother.flavor_text: Cut from the root the warren grew round.

The Thorn-Mother.name: Bristleback Hauberk
The Thorn-Mother.flavor_text: Quills on the shoulders, iron underneath.

The Erased.name: Nameless Signet
The Erased.flavor_text: Whoever wore it is gone. So is their name.

The Last Editor.name: The Red Quill
The Last Editor.flavor_text: Every mark it makes is final.

The Last Editor.name: Vellum Robes
The Last Editor.flavor_text: Scraped clean and written over, more than once.

The Keeper of the First Page.name: The First Page
The Keeper of the First Page.flavor_text: The oldest thing anyone has ever written, on a chain.

The Keeper of the First Page.name: Keeper's Lexicon Staff
The Keeper of the First Page.flavor_text: Every word it knows is a spell.

The Keeper of the First Page.name: Bindings of the Vault
The Keeper of the First Page.flavor_text: Iron bands that held the oldest books shut.

The Keeper of the First Page.name: Ink-Black Hauberk
The Keeper of the First Page.flavor_text: Dyed in the vault's own ink.
